events.name: Directory of Good Samaritans and Daughters of Samaria -- Sheba Lodge (standing ad, confirmed on Aug 17 p4)

events.description: Standing lodge directory headed 'DIRECTORY Of I.O. of Good Samaritans and Daughters of Samaria.' SHEBA LODGE, Juvenile I.O. of Good Samaritans and D. of Samaria, meets 2d Thursday of each month at 3 o'clock P.M. at Masonic Hall, South Eleventh Street (dated Feb 23-1yr). Officers printed: A. Cropper, F.G.; S. Young, P.G. (The Aug 17 printing was faint and I first read the second officer as 'B. Young'; the clearer Aug 24 and Aug 31 printings confirm it is 'S. YOUNG' -- resolved, no flag.) This directory, Sheba Lodge and A. Cropper were ALSO captured by readers A and C from other issues this quarter -- duplicate; independent reading recorded here (Aug 17/24/31 p4) for officer verification. Do not double-enter.
